user.title: Create Label State
user.description: Create a binary sensor that is on if any entity with the label meets the criteria.

numeric_state.title: Label Numeric State
numeric_state.description: Create a binary sensor that is on if any entities value with the label is outside of its normal bounds.

data_description.label: Select the label assigned to the entities to monitor. Labels assigned to devices or areas are ignored.
data_description.name: Name of the binary sensor to create.
data_description.state_lower_limit: Turn on when any monitored entity has a numeric state below this value. Set at least one bound; values equal to the bound do not trigger the sensor.
data_description.state_upper_limit: Turn on when any monitored entity has a numeric state above this value. Set at least one bound; values equal to the bound do not trigger the sensor.

state.title: Label State
state.description: Create a binary sensor that is on if any entity with the label has the specified state.

data_description.label: Select the label assigned to the entities to monitor. Labels assigned to devices or areas are ignored.
data_description.name: Name of the binary sensor to create.
data_description.state_to: Turn on when any monitored entity matches this state. Select a state or enter a custom state. Matching is case-insensitive.

state_not.title: Label Not State
state_not.description: Create a binary sensor that is on if any entity with the label does not have the specified state.

data_description.label: Select the label assigned to the entities to monitor. Labels assigned to devices or areas are ignored.
data_description.name: Name of the binary sensor to create.
data_description.state_not: Turn on when any monitored entity differs from this state, including unknown or unavailable states. Select a state or enter a custom state. Matching is case-insensitive.
